attributions.author: José João de Almeida, Rui Vilela and Alberto Simões (Projecto Natura, Universidade do Minho)
attributions.changes: Every stem was unfolded through its affix rules into the forms it accepts, in the spelling of the 1990 agreement, and each form written in the capitals A to Z — accents and the cedilla dropped. Proper names, abbreviations and forms holding a hyphen were left out, as were the ones shorter than two letters or longer than nine. The words a hidden word is drawn from are its common nouns, adjectives and infinitives of five to eight letters, ranked by how often films say them, minus crude words and a few a reading judged unfit.

attributions.author: Hermit Dave, counting OpenSubtitles 2018
attributions.changes: Its Portuguese word counts rank the hidden words into three tiers and mark the long forms a table would know on the reveal; no word is taken from it.
